title: FastAPI for AI Applications
key_concepts: FastAPI request lifecycle and async/await patterns
Pydantic v2 models for request/response validation
CORS middleware configuration for frontend integration
expected_skills: Build a REST API with FastAPI for an LLM-backed service
Use Pydantic models for input validation and output shaping
Implement async endpoints that call external AI APIs
Add CORS, rate limiting, and authentication middleware
sample_questions: Why use FastAPI over Flask for an AI API service? What advantages does async bring?
How does Pydantic v2 validate request data and what happens when validation fails?
Explain how you would use FastAPI's BackgroundTasks for processing long-running AI jobs.
How would you add rate limiting to a FastAPI endpoint to prevent API abuse?
